144)༈a yag lags/sngags chog rnams las/dwangs bcud bdag la thim par sogs kyi bdag zhes pa'i go ba/sngags chog 'don pa'i skyabs sems dus nas bdag gzhan mnyam

tei:div.tei:p: 144) ༈ a yag lags/ sngags chog rnams las/ dwangs bcud bdag la thim par sogs kyi bdag zhes pa'i go ba/ sngags chog 'don pa'i skyabs sems dus nas bdag gzhan mnyam brje tshul bzhin bsgoms nas/ de phyin bdag gsar pa sems can thams cad la go dgos/ gzhan rang gi sngar gyi phung khams la go ba las/ sngags chog gi bdag rang 'dod yid byed la gaun/ sngags chog des tshe gcig sangs rgyas lta zhog 'khor rtsa mi chod pa'i steng*/ 'khor rtsa bdag 'dzin gyi snon mar yang 'gyur bas/ lam des tshogs bsags pa sogs kyis btegs na nyan/ ma thegs na brnab sems dngos su 'gyur bas 'khor rtsa je 'phel du mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu dngos yin no/ de sogs sngags la mtha' drug tshul bzhis go dgos pa las/ thad dkar go na ru tra'i rgyur 'gyur ba lags// dge'o//
